title: AcademicAntiPatternContract
description: Contract schema for cataloging methodological, statistical, rhetorical, and typographical anti-patterns to prevent recurrence.

anti_pattern_id.description: Unique identifier for this anti-pattern (e.g. AP-STAT-MEDIAN-SPLIT-001).

defective_pattern.description: Description of the defective or discredited approach (e.g. Dichotomizing continuous moderators via median split).

why_defective.description: Mathematical or methodological justification for why this pattern is prohibited.

observed_symptoms.description: Concrete indicators or metrics revealing the anti-pattern (e.g. 50% power loss, inflated Type I error).

corrective_remedy.description: The approved, compliant replacement technique (e.g. Hayes PROCESS Model 1 continuous moderation).

source_pitfall_id.description: Optional reference to pitfall record in state/pitfalls.jsonl.

reusable.description: Whether this anti-pattern should be actively screened across all research projects.
